kind: passive executed-output receipt; no recipe implementation
canonical_commit_role: Source-and-test qualification checkpoint; receipt delivery is qualified separately.

supersedes.reason: Concurrent entry exposure could alias shared hash cells; the actual previous owner returned10320 for a stable entry whose required hash was10352.

change: TreeBidiMap keeps dual red-black indexes in owner arrays. This successor serializes entry-cell allocation/publication, checks and publishes shared lazy hashes under the page monitor with user callbacks outside monitors, and publishes projection-local cached hashes through a volatile flag.

compatibility.serialization: Original UID/fields and exact fixture streams preserved.
compatibility.entry_identity_delta: Forward entry requests create fresh immutable caller-owned projections; key/value representatives remain unchanged.
compatibility.lazy_hash_behavior: Shared entry hash cache, uncached direct map.hashCode and finite same-cell reentrant last-completion order preserved.
compatibility.concurrency_scope: Stable-payload entry readers followed by joined/external synchronization before mutation; no new concurrent-writer or mutable-payload race guarantee.

native_functional.source_epoch: exact final production and regression test

new_regressions.first_completion_negative: expected outer reentrant hash 11, observed nested hash 7

measurement.method: One fresh original/successor JVM pair, 180 raw samples and180 validated checksums, plus structural runs; standalone uncontended diagnostics, not JMH or contention throughput.
measurement.structural_definition: Reachable Java structural bytes excluding key/value payloads and native monitor metadata; shared empty arrays are not exclusive per-map retained bytes.

cpu_ratios_at_16384.definition: candidate/baseline, one pair of five-sample JVM medians

measurement.tradeoffs: Larger empty/singleton footprint, fresh-entry allocation, slower small/medium lookups and slower entry/entry-hash traversal. Earlier three-pair results belong to the superseded source epoch.

original_default_lifecycle.observation: Original RAT goal on the source-received tree, including its existing passive receipt, reports exactly the three historical files below. Receipt replacement receives a separate final RAT observation in canonical qualification.

disposition: Qualified storage successor; draft while the historical original RAT/default-lifecycle hold and target integration checks remain unresolved.
